history.summary: A freehold 2BR (Flora View, D20) at $1.05M / $1,394 psf — a low, liquid quantum and an efficient 753 sqft layout, but 1.5km / 18-min from Yio Chu Kang MRT and with no URA appreciation/transaction data. A boutique freehold value entry whose main drawback is poor transit and an unverified price.
history.rating_rationale: The sub-$1.1M quantum keeps the buyer pool deep and the freehold/efficient layout are positives, but the 1.5km (18-min) walk to MRT is a real demerit for a 2BR that leans on rental/investor demand, and there is no project URA data to validate the $1,394 psf or any appreciation trend. Likely a small boutique block (thinner liquidity). D20 (Bishan/Ang Mo Kio belt) is a stable mature estate but this specific Flora Road pocket is transit-poor — a balanced Neutral.
red_flags: 1.5km / 18-min to Yio Chu Kang MRT — weak connectivity
